report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with durations 78-203ms; metrics show zero 502s and no error logs. The alert's 230ms p95 is not clearly anomalous without a baseline, and dependency metrics are empty, so no public cause is substantiated. Insufficient evidence to name a root cause; need downstream and baseline data.
missing_evidence: Dependency-level metrics for gateway->order calls (simulator_dependency_operations_total returned empty) to attribute latency to a downstream
Order service latency/error metrics and logs to test downstream-latency hypothesis
Baseline p95 for /v1/checkout to determine whether 230ms is anomalous
Error/exception logs or 5xx responses to support http-500 or db-pool-exhaustion
Redis/inventory and payment latency metrics to rule out redis-timeout or downstream-latency
